h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Amritsar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Amritsar

items.pText: Amritsar's marriage palaces, farmhouses and banquet lawns host big family gatherings, and there are always children who need somewhere to play while the adults celebrate. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment in Amritsar to these venues, as well as to schools, housing colonies and parks. Our factory in Vasai is about 1,380 km away, and we send each order by road for installation by our team or a dealer.

An event venue uses a playground differently from a school. It may stand quiet for days and then take fifty children in one evening, many of them in party clothes and in the dark. That calls for pieces several children can use at once, smooth roto-moulded surfaces with no sharp edges, and a spot that is lit and clearly visible from the main lawn. Punjab's weather adds its own demands. Summers are very hot, winters are cold and foggy, and galvanised steel holds up well through both.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: Play areas for marriage palaces and farmhouse lawns

c: Place the play area within sight of the guest seating but well away from the stage, generators, catering and parking. Light it well, since most functions run into the night. A themed multi play system from
or Castle Crest gives children a clear place to gather, with see-saws and a merry-go-round around it.
Fence the area lightly so toddlers do not wander off. After each event, ask staff to check for food, plates and decorations left on the equipment. Our

items.q: Which playground equipment suits a wedding or banquet venue?
items.a: Pieces that many children can use together, such as a multi play system, merry-go-round and double see-saws. Choose smooth roto-moulded parts and place the area where parents can see it.

items.q: Can the equipment stay outside through Punjab's winter?
items.a: Yes. Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic are weather-proof and do not rust in fog or dew. Wipe the surfaces dry before use on damp mornings.

items.q: Do you install playground equipment in Amritsar?
items.a: Yes. We manufacture at Vasai, send the equipment to Amritsar by road and install it with our own team or a dealer, using grouting or a self-standing base.
